title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week’s spotlight is Electric Light Orchestra’s “Mr. Blue Sky” — a bright classic-pop lift with sunny harmonies, theatrical sparkle, and the kind of feel-good energy that can turn the room toward instant smiles. It gives Djembe a joyful, recognizable feature moment with a big golden-hour glow.
songListNote: Electric Light Orchestra’s sunny classic-pop favorite, bringing joyful, theatrical, high-energy uplift to the show rotation.
